decisions.decision: Shared setup lives in app/tools/e2e-pw-common.js (initEnv, startRoom, joinPlayers, openMod3d, startGame, makeChecker, makeWatch, loadPw, clickIf); e2e-pw.js keeps game loop, oracle checks and sheets
decisions.why: AC-1 one copy and unchanged behaviour; rejected copy-paste into the new script and making e2e-pw.js import the voice script

decisions.decision: seat = page index 0..11, tone 220+40*seat Hz, engine pid mapped by player name only for marker checks
decisions.why: audio path is independent of server pid shuffling; rejected using pid as the tone seat

decisions.decision: Remote track mapped to sender seat by MediaStream id (msid) of the injected fake-mic stream; ICE-ufrag match is the documented fallback
decisions.why: works for mod3d (module-scoped socket unreachable) and phones with one RTCPeerConnection wrapper and no product change; rejected hooking socket v:sig; [verify] msid equality in smoke run

decisions.decision: Page hook owns a separate AudioContext (48 kHz): per-sender Analyser (FFT 8192, smoothing 0), a summed mix Analyser, and a MediaRecorder on the mix for mod3d and P01
decisions.why: ground-truth per sender without touching the product graph; rejected patching voice.js or recording page output

decisions.decision: Checks run post-hoc on 100 ms in-page samples stamped with Date.now; slot window = last 800 ms of 1500; constants T_ON 0.10, T_OFF 0.01, FLOOR_DB -60, +-1 bin
decisions.why: avoids latency races between script and pages and keeps one place for thresholds; constants are tunable, rules are not

decisions.decision: AC-4 silence check = per-seat RMS plus mix magnitude at P05 bins plus no speaking marker plus leak-regex diff on 11 pages; AC-3 also checks P01 hears 11
decisions.why: RMS alone would pass if the mesh were simply broken; extra evidence costs nothing, same data

decisions.decision: Videos from recordVideo (paths after ctx.close), audio blobs out as base64 via page.evaluate, alignment by page-creation epoch and recorder start epoch, trimming with ffmpeg trim/atrim filters
decisions.why: Playwright webm has no seek index and pages start at different times; rejected -ss input seeking

decisions.decision: ffmpeg grid: 1920x1080, mod3d 1256x785 at left, 12 phones 166x360 as 4x3 on the right, mod3d received mix as aac soundtrack, H.264 yuv420p 25 fps
decisions.why: fits 4x3 phones plus a large 16:10 mod3d in one canvas; no subtitles per ac.md

decisions.decision: ffmpeg probe (-version, -encoders libx264/aac) is step 0 before server/browser/wipe; FFMPEG env set = no PATH fallback; clip verified via ffmpeg -i stderr, no ffprobe
decisions.why: AC-7 fail fast; one binary dependency

decisions.decision: Voice enabled by page.evaluate(Voice.toggle) as in e2e-voice-browser.js; Chromium args disable mDNS host-candidate hiding and background throttling
decisions.why: avoids overlay-click flake; 288 local peer connections need real host candidates

decisions.decision: Platform cli, no ADR, no diagram; port default 3341; output dir wiped at start; extra raw/samples-*.json for debugging
decisions.why: dev tool with no new component; AC-6 raw list is a minimum

summary: contract.md index + 9 parts: shared helper, page hooks (msid sender mapping), slot timeline/thresholds, clip/ffmpeg, report schema; no product hook gap, no blockers.
